description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class implementing Symfony's SessionStorageInterface for in-memory session management within the OrangeHRM project. It manages session bags, handles session lifecycle methods, and integrates with session metadata.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements session storage using in-memory arrays, managing session bags and metadata within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session, here it's a no-op that returns true.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session has started; here always returns true.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the session ID, here an empty string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the session ID; implementation is empty.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the session name, defaulting to 'SESSID'.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the session name; implementation is empty.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID; optionally destroys old session data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the session; implementation is empty.

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name; throws exception if not registered.
